caseName: Walsh v. United States ex rel. White
caseNameFull: Walsh, Sheriff v. United States ex rel. White
attorneys: John S. Boyle for petitioner. Joseph I. Bulger and Ode L. Rankin for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The petition for writ of certiorari is granted. The judgment of the Court of Appeals is reversed and the cause is remanded to the District Court with directions to discharge the writ of habeas corpus and remand the re*805spondent to custody.

John S. Boyle for petitioner. Joseph I. Bulger and Ode L. Rankin for respondent.
